entries.author: Lance Ship
entries.description: Monophonic average-magnitude-difference pitch and level tracker for external audio. It reports native Ksoloti pitch, smoothed mean-absolute level, AMDF confidence, and an explicit validity gate while retaining the last accepted pitch. Tags: analysis, pitch, AMDF, level, confidence, external-audio, monophonic.

entries.author: Lance Ship
entries.description: Record and morph between two to eight four-channel control scenes. Position scans adjacent scenes with linear, smooth, or stepped interpolation. Tags: control, scenes, morph, keyframes, recordable, deterministic.
entries.disposition_rationale: Exact library attribution does not identify Mutable Instruments-derived code or data.

entries.author: Lance Ship
entries.description: Four phase-related bipolar modulation outputs with continuously variable rise/fall balance, curvature, and smoothing. It free-runs from 0.02 to 40 Hz or measures an external clock and locks one cycle to its period. Outputs are control-rate and deterministic. Tags: modulation, function-generator, LFO, clock-sync, quadrature, bounded.
entries.disposition_rationale: Exact library attribution does not identify Mutable Instruments-derived code or data.

entries.author: Lance Ship
entries.description: Six chained ramp segments for envelopes, looping modulation, stepped sequences, and held stages. Each segment has an independent target and duration. Tags: modulation, envelope, function-generator, sequencer, slew, loopable.
entries.disposition_rationale: Exact library attribution does not identify Mutable Instruments-derived code or data.

entries.author: Lance Ship

entries.disposition_rationale: Exact library attribution does not identify Mutable Instruments-derived code or data.

entries.author: Lance Ship; DSP by Emilie Gillet
entries.description: Polyphonic physical resonator with modal, sympathetic-string, and dispersive-string models. It accepts external audio excitation or generates an internal pluck on a rising strum, and returns complementary main and auxiliary responses. Uses the MIT-licensed Rings DSP carried by Ksoloti. Tags: physical-model, resonator, modal, string, exciter, polyphonic, stereo-pair, heavy.
entries.disposition_rationale: The exact license identifies a GPL wrapper around the MIT Rings DSP by Emilie Gillet; its excitation and configurable physical resonation match the reviewed family.

entries.author: Lance Ship
entries.description: Seeded 1-to-16-step random memory. On each rising clock, memory controls the probability of replaying the current slot: 0 produces fresh values, 64 locks a repeatable loop, and intermediate values make bounded mutations. Spread and bias reshape the stored loop without destroying it. Tags: random, loop, mutation, stepped-CV, deterministic, seedable, generative.
entries.disposition_rationale: Exact library attribution does not identify Mutable Instruments-derived code or data.

entries.author: Lance Ship
entries.description: Seeded complementary probability router. A rising trigger produces a one-block pulse on exactly one output; probability 0 always selects B, probability 64 always selects A, and choice retains the last decision. Tags: random, Bernoulli, gate, complementary, deterministic, seedable.
entries.disposition_rationale: Exact library attribution does not identify Mutable Instruments-derived code or data.

entries.author: Lance Ship
entries.description: Seeded clock pulse randomizer with probability, variable width, and width variation. Each input edge also captures a repeatable random value. Tags: random, pulse, clock, probability, seedable, deterministic.
entries.disposition_rationale: Exact library attribution does not identify Mutable Instruments-derived code or data.

entries.author: Lance Ship
entries.description: Continuously interpolated seeded bipolar random modulation, free-running or advanced by external clock. Tags: random, smooth, modulation, seedable, clocked, deterministic.
entries.disposition_rationale: Exact library attribution does not identify Mutable Instruments-derived code or data.

entries.author: Lance Ship; pattern data by Emilie Gillet
entries.description: Three-channel 32-step rhythm sequencer that bilinearly interpolates a two-dimensional pattern map. X and Y move between related grooves, three densities reveal progressively more events, chaos perturbs thresholds once per pattern, and accents mark the strongest events. Uses GPL-3.0-or-later pattern data derived from Grids. Tags: sequencer, rhythm, drum, topographic, density, chaos, accent, seedable.
entries.disposition_rationale: Task 030 assigns one exact function-first family and catalog implementation; Mutable ancestry remains a separate provenance facet and establishes no support.

entries.author: Lance Ship; DSP by Emilie Gillet
entries.description: Complete 24-engine Plaits macro voice with main and auxiliary outputs, internal trigger envelope and low-pass gate, optional drone and external-level modes, and modulation of pitch, harmonics, timbre, and morph. Engines 0-7 are the later virtual-analog-filter, phase-distortion, six-operator FM, wave-terrain, string-machine, and chiptune additions; engines 8-23 are the original tonal, noise, physical, and percussion models. Tags: synthesis, macro-voice, 24-engine, speech, FM, physical-model, percussion, Plaits-DSP, very-heavy.
